bibl.title: Nubica onomastica miscellanea III. Notes on and corrections to personal names found in Christian Nubian written sources.
bibl.seg: 145.13 C.P.R. IV, 28 O. Alex. sans No d'Inv. P. Lond. Copt. I, 450
Grzegorz Ochała, Nubica onomastica miscellanea III. Notes on and corrections to personal names found in Christian Nubian written sources.
bibl.note: A. Northern Nubia: 1. P. Lond. Copt. I, 450 (DBMNT 631): deed of land sale; - 2. C.P.R. IV, 28 (DBMNT 636): deed of land sale; - 3. S.B. Kopt. I, 37 [= O. Alex. sans No d'Inv.] (DBMNT 2056): entagion. - B. Ginari: 4. Epitaph of the woman Toub( ) (DBMNT 408); - 5. Epitaph of the man Ichilos (DBMNT 411); - 6. Epitaph of the woman Sion (DBMNT 413); - 7. Epitaph of Seueros (DBMNT 442); - 8. Epitaph of the woman Mprrhote? (DBMNT 445); - 9. Epitaph of Abraham (DBMNT 450). - C. Amada: 10. Inscription [in Old Nubian] left by Okkeri mentioning King Kouddapes (DBMNT 1537). - D. Arminna: 11. Epitaph [in Coptic] of Marianta (DBMNT 523). - E. Tamit: 12. Inscription [in Old Nubian] mentioning King Ioel and Bishop Merki (DBMNT 723). - F. Sahaba: 13. Inscription of Maristi son of Zael (DBMNT 1444). - G. Abd el-Qadir: 14. Inscription [in Old Nubian] of Masi (DBMNT 1698). - H. Kulubnarti: 15. [An Old Nubian leather document which is] perhaps a deed requesting donation (DBMNT 594). - I. Ghazali: 16. Epitaph of Epimachos, formerly Eudokia daughter of Elisabeth (DBMNT 473); - 17. Inscription of Mariane (DBMNT 2505); - 18. Inscription of Isou (DBMNT 2543). - J. Soba: 19. Inscription of Mariame (DBMNT 2488). - Appendix: Index of corrected names.
